title: On the Emergence of Implicit Curriculum in RLVR Learning Dynamics
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been a main driver of recent breakthroughs in large reasoning models. Yet it remains a mystery how rewards based solely on final outcomes can help overcome the long-horizon barrier to extended reasoning. To understand this, we develop a theory of the training dynamics of RLVR for transformers on compositional reasoning tasks.
